ideas.title: Idea bank
ideas.intro: The ideas you approved in your feedback PDF, with the same numbering, working with the site's current content. Where material is still missing, the demo uses an example and says what is missing. At the end, the ones left for later and the discarded ones.
ideas.missingLabel: What we still need from you:

legend.live: works on the site with the current content.
legend.waiting: works, but the final result depends on material from you.

carousel.title: Carousel with the featured piece
carousel.adjustment: no finishes, no "view piece" and no "view in 3D"; clicking the photo opens the piece.
carousel.description: The piece in the centre is large and its neighbours smaller. Drag or use the arrows: the next piece grows and the name changes with it. Clicking the photo opens the piece's page.

scroll.title: Parallax and reveal on scroll
scroll.description: While scrolling, the background, the piece and the text move at slightly different speeds, in a short movement. Photos open like a curtain when they enter the screen, and titles rise a little while they appear. Scroll slowly to see it.

scenes.title: Room with clickable points
scenes.description: A photo of a furnished room with a point on each piece. The point opens the piece's photo and name, which lead to its page. Set up in the panel, under Content, Rooms: click on the photo, choose the piece and save.
scenes.missing: photos of furnished rooms with the pieces (landscape, high resolution) and which pieces appear in each photo.
scenes.demoNote: Example with a collection photo and three real pieces in illustrative positions, only to show how it works.

finish.title: Detail magnifier and materials strip
finish.adjustment: on the finishes page, with a fixed high-resolution image.
finish.description: On the Finishes page, clicking a sample opens the finish in a large fixed image, whole or at real size, to browse the texture.
finish.missing: high-resolution scans of the finishes (2500 px or more), with the name and code of each.

morph.title: Page transition with the photo
morph.description: When you click a piece, the card photo grows into the large photo on the piece's page. Try it on one of the pieces below.

micro.title: Micro-interactions
micro.adjustment: confirm which ones will be used.
micro.description: Small movements that answer what the visitor does. Each one is below, on its own, so you can choose which ones stay: the ones not chosen are removed without touching the others.

arrow.title: Arrow that slides on the button
arrow.body: On hover, the arrow on the button and on the link slides a little to the right.

underline.title: Underline that grows
underline.body: On hover over a text link, the underline grows from left to right, as in the menu and the footer.

drag.title: "Drag" cursor on the carousel
drag.body: Over the carousel in idea 01, the cursor becomes a circle with the word "Drag". Hover over the pieces up there.

added.title: Wishlist confirmation
added.body: When a piece goes into the list, the button shows a check and "Added to the list", and the list icon at the top of the page pulses once. Try it: the piece really goes into the list and can be removed later.

count.title: Numbers that count up
count.body: Numbers count up to their value when they appear on screen, like the ones on the Factory page. These come from the current catalogue.

loading.title: Smooth loading
loading.body: While a photo or a list loads, a light band passes over its space, instead of the word "Loading…".

video.title: Short looping video in the banner
video.description: The banner accepts a short silent video that loops over the photo. It only downloads when the banner is on screen; visitors who asked for less motion or data saving see the photo.
video.missing: a 10 to 20 second silent MP4 video for the banner. Upload it in the panel, under Banners.
video.note: There is no banner with a video yet: below, the banner with its photo.
